defs.def: to have sb/sth as parts or members 包括；包含；由 … 组成

ex.s: It is the world’s largest reef system and comprises around 3,000 individual reefs.
ex.t: 它是世界上最大的珊瑚礁系统，由大约3000个单独的珊瑚礁组成。

ex.s: The main body comprises paragraphs with supporting evidence and facts.
ex.t: 正文包括具有支持证据和事实的段落。

ex.s: The 15th century: Zheng He sailed to South-east Asia, South Asia, West Asia, and East Africa Some of his voyages comprised as many as sixty treasure ships.
ex.t: 15世纪：郑和航行于东南亚、南亚、西亚、东非等地。他的一些航行包括多达60艘宝船。

ex.s: It is expanding at such a rate that we can only imagine what it will comprise in the future.
ex.t: 它的扩张速度如此之快，以至于我们只能想象它在未来将包括什么。

ex.s: Background information • The Belt and Road Initiative comprises the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road, and is designed to connect Asia with the rest of the world.
ex.t: 背景信息 "一带一路"倡议包括丝绸之路经济带和21世纪海上丝绸之路，旨在将亚洲与世界其他地区连接起来。

defs.def: to be the parts or members that form sth 是（某事物的）组成部分；组成；构成

chunks.cn: 与 路 倡议 包括
包括 在…里 该 将来
